# PurePeptide

> Bulgarian supplier of lyophilised research peptides with >99% purity, verified by HPLC and LC-MS
> at the independent laboratory Janoshik Analytical. All products are sold strictly for laboratory
> and scientific research purposes (Research Use Only) and are not medicinal products.

Prices are shown in EUR (BGN in parallel on purepeptide.bg; RON, CZK, HUF and PLN on the local
storefronts). Payment: cash on delivery or bank transfer. Shipping: Econt, BoxNow, Speedy and
Pigeon in Bulgaria, FAN Courier, Speedex and GLS across the EU.

## Store

- [Home](https://purepeptide.bg/): storefront entry point
- [All peptides](https://purepeptide.bg/api/llms.txt): the full catalogue with prices and stock (live list)
- [Lab analysis & COA](https://purepeptide.bg/pages/chemical-analysis): HPLC / LC-MS certificates per batch
- [Scientific articles](https://purepeptide.bg/pages/articles): research summaries per peptide
- [FAQ](https://purepeptide.bg/pages/faq): storage, reconstitution, delivery and payment questions
- [Contact](https://purepeptide.bg/pages/contact-1): e-mail, phone and contact form
